info.title: KamiErabi GOD.app
info.synopsis: Goro è uno studente del primo anno di una scuola superiore privata a Tokyo. Il mondo gli è indifferente e prova un vago desiderio per Honoka, una compagna di classe della stessa scuola. Lui e il suo migliore amico Akitsu vivono una vita noiosa, finché un giorno Goro riceve una strana notifica sul suo smartphone: “Sei stato scelto. Esprimi il tuo desiderio."

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: Ono Goro, a young man with few friends and poor mental health, is appalled to find out he's not hallucinating when he's informed that he's acquired superhuman abilities and must battle others in a death game.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Goro used his new karma-twisting powers to resurrect Honoka. The two of them form an alliance along with his friend and fellow God candidate Akitsu, and Honoka provides them with an explanation of some of the details of their new status as candidates.

episodes.title: Episodio 3

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: Honoka tells a depressed Goro about Little Angel, who can resolve any problem a person might have. Chika from the Science Club joins in the hunt, and they discover that Tatsuya is Little Angel. But Tatsuya is already the target of Koki the delinquent...

tmdb.synopsis: Honoka tells a depressed Goro about Little Angel, who can resolve any problem a person might have. Chika from the Science Club joins in the hunt, and they discover that Tatsuya is Little Angel. But Tatsuya is already the target of Koki the delinquent...

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: After a late-night SOS call from Chika, Goro heads to school. There he finds Koki fighting off a bunch of students wearing strange masks. Upon figuring out that "Little Angel" Tatsuya is a God candidate, Goro sets out with Koki and Chika to stop him.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: After a late-night SOS call from Chika, Goro heads to school. There he finds Koki fighting off a bunch of students wearing strange masks. Upon figuring out that "Little Angel" Tatsuya is a God candidate, Goro sets out with Koki and Chika to stop him.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: Goro accidentally bought two tickets for his favorite idol Iyo's concert, so he invites Koki along. After learning that Koki has become a KamiErabi God candidate in Tatsuya's place, Goro ends up running into Iyo in a men's bathroom just prior to the show.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: Goro accidentally bought two tickets for his favorite idol Iyo's concert, so he invites Koki along. After learning that Koki has become a KamiErabi God candidate in Tatsuya's place, Goro ends up running into Iyo in a men's bathroom just prior to the show.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Honoka attempts to murder Goro, who's currently incapacitated due to the repeated use of his power. But after Koki and Lall hinder her, a frustrated Honoka encounters Chika while attempting to leave the hospital. Events then take a turn for the bizarre.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: During Goro's recovery celebration at the arcade, sexy actress Mitsuko suddenly climbs out of the TV. She asks for help rescuing her friend from a meddling God candidate named Keita. Meanwhile, Honoka tries to get info about other candidates from Chika.

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: During Goro's recovery celebration at the arcade, sexy actress Mitsuko suddenly climbs out of the TV. She asks for help rescuing her friend from a meddling God candidate named Keita. Meanwhile, Honoka tries to get info about other candidates from Chika.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: Falsely branded as fugitives, Goro's group forms a new alliance with Honoka and Chika. They use Mitsuko's power to leap through space and escape Keita's attack, but a navigational blunder on Mitsuko's part leads them to a surprise acquaintance of Keita's.

tmdb.title: Episodio 9

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Honoka, Koki, and Chika find themselves forced into a harrowing battle against Kyo. Goro and Iyo begin to question their own powers and the true significance of the KamiErabi. Iyo presses Lall for information, but she claims to not remember anything.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Kyo died young before a treatment could be found for his disease, but Ryo wished him back into being when she became a God candidate. Now Kyo has full control of the parallel worlds Ryo creates, and he asks Goro to help him establish a utopia for her.

tmdb.title: Episodio 11
tmdb.synopsis: Kyo died young before a treatment could be found for his disease, but Ryo wished him back into being when she became a God candidate. Now Kyo has full control of the parallel worlds Ryo creates, and he asks Goro to help him establish a utopia for her.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Goro succeeds in stopping Kyo and Ryo, but the use of his power robs him of the relationships he's established with his fellow God candidates. Lall alone remains by his side, and Goro confronts his own past in order to recall his long-forgotten true wish.
